content: withastro/action is a composite action: detects package manager from lockfile, installs deps, runs build via '$PACKAGE_MANAGER run build' (or custom build-cmd input). Composite steps inherit the job/runner env, so default GitHub env vars incl. GITHUB_SHA are visible to the astro build process (process.env.GITHUB_SHA in .astro frontmatter at build time). Inputs: node-version (default 24), package-manager, path, build-cmd, cache, cache-dir, out-dir.
